ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 35:65 high-intensity white/light-gray to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity black pixel mass occupies the central and medial regions of both lobes. High-intensity white contiguous blocks are located at the extreme lateral tips. High-contrast white linear patterns and mottling are overlaid across the central black regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 65 degrees and significant depth relative to the lobe horizontal axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency and high-amplitude irregular serrations present along the entire continuous trailing edge; characterized by jagged peaks and valleys especially prominent on the right lobe boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-modal curve exhibiting concavity near the median notch transitioning into a broad convex sweep toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clustered high-contrast, multi-tonal (white and tan) irregular pixel groups localized at the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of high-contrast white linear pixel disruptions (parallel rake marks) spanning the low-intensity black regions of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive parallel linear scarring consistent with predatory rake marks across the majority of the fluke surface; significant biological encrustation at distal lobe tips.
other_distinctive_markers: A small, dark circular pixel anomaly with a distinct border located on the upper-right white region of the fluke tip.
